For your casual backyard barbecue on a warm summer afternoon, here is a playlist of upbeat country and reggae songs designed to enhance the laid-back vibe and encourage guests to relax and enjoy each other's company:

1. "Three Little Pigs" - Zac Brown Band
2. "Island in the Sun" - Weezer
3. "Chicken Fried" - Zac Brown Band
4. "Three Little Birds" - Bob Marley & The Wailers
5. "Wagon Wheel" - Darius Rucker
6. "No Woman, No Cry" - Bob Marley & The Wailers
7. "Body Like a Back Road" - Sam Hunt
8. "Jamming" - Bob Marley & The Wailers
9. "Tennessee Whiskey" - Chris Stapleton
10. "Could You Be Loved" - Bob Marley & The Wailers
11. "Die a Happy Man" - Thomas Rhett
12. "Red Red Wine" - UB40
13. "Drunk on a Plane" - Dierks Bentley
14. "Stir It Up" - Bob Marley & The Wailers
15. "Sun Don't Let Me Down" - Zac Brown Band

Enjoy your barbecue!
